scope: Locate 2026 Font Explorer keyboard navigation and Symbol preview crosshair

keyboard.ArrowUp: Previous font in the current filtered list
keyboard.ArrowDown: Next font in the current filtered list
keyboard.selection: Paging preserves the selected character and Unicode range; font navigation uses the existing pointer-selection path.
keyboard.boundaries: Clamp at first/last font and top/bottom character page; empty filters are safe.
keyboard.focus: Preserve virtual font-row focus. Editable fields, modified arrows, other panels, modal dialogs and closed Explorer retain their normal behaviour.
keyboard.reveal: Selection reveal tracks selection changes, not virtual-cell recycling; explicit paging cancels older queued reveal callbacks.

crosshair.default: New sessions use pale grey; explicit session choices remain.

scenarios: 1000-entry filtered virtual font list, limits and no-match filter
Editable controls, modifiers, focus and closed drawer
Six crosshair swatches, pale grey default and saved choice
PNG/SVG export remains unchanged by crosshair colours
Responsive preview header and compact export layout
Large Unicode range, Find selected, Home/End and initial grid coverage
